scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json && node scripts/build-templates.mjs && mkdir -p public/styles public/icons && cp styles/*.css public/styles/ && ( cp icons/*.png icons/*.svg public/icons/ 2>/dev/null || true ) && cp manifest.webmanifest public/manifest.webmanifest && node scripts/build-sw.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm test && npm --prefix api test
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p tsconfig.sw.json --noEmit && npm run lint
